items.label: Natural Lift & Seamless Comfort
items.value: Our push-up T-shirt bras feature medium padding and moderate lift with seamless, invisible technology that disappears under clothing. The demi-coverage (3/4 cup) offers a flattering lower-cut look while staying invisible.

items.label: Wireless Support for All-Day Wear
items.value: Designed for daily comfort, the wire-free bras have a wide underband with thin elastic to prevent shifting and provide gentle yet secure support—no poking wires, just smooth medium coverage that stays in place.

items.label: Buttery-Soft Second-Skin Fabric
items.value: Made from ultra-stretchy "butter fabric" with 360° flexibility, this bra feels like a second skin—lightweight, breathable, and irresistibly smooth against your body.

items.label: Flattering & Functional Design
items.value: Wide back straps and side panels smooth back lines and tame underarm bulge, while the adjustable 4-row hooks and convertible straps customize the fit. Extra-wide underband ensures no ride-up for all-day comfort.

items.label: Confidently Invisible & All-Day Secure
items.value: The double-layer front lining guarantees absolute coverage—no nipple show-through even under white shirts or workout tops. Featuring fully seamless edges and smooth molded cups, this bra disappears under everything from office blouses to yoga tanks.
